subject: LumenBank: personnel proof inventory + redaction/walkthrough request
messages:
From: LumenBank Compliance <compliance@lumenbank.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: S. Patel <s.patel@lumenbank.com>
Date: Sat, 02 May 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Request: personnel training/background & offboarding evidence for SOC 2 mapping

Vanessa —

Thanks for the quick onboarding yesterday. As part of LumenBank's vendor review for our SOC 2 mapping we need a short package showing how Redwood handles employee onboarding, training completion, background checks, and deprovisioning timelines. Our auditor has provided a narrow scope: control families related to personnel (HR1/HR2 equivalents).

Specifically we need:
- A roster (CSV) with non-PII identifiers and training completion dates for the last 12 months.
- Confirmation from your background-check vendor that candidate checks were completed (statement or redacted evidence).
- A sample offboarding timeline showing how access, keys, and other privileges are revoked (timestamped events are ideal).
- The standard retention policy for personnel records and where redacted artifacts will be stored.

Can you provide an initial bundle by end of day Tuesday (2026-05-04)? If there are any PII/PI concerns, please advise on the redaction approach up front. We prefer a sample for 10 users (mix of contractors and employees).

Thanks,
Maya Brooks
Director, Vendor Risk — LumenBank
compliance@lumenbank.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: LumenBank Compliance <compliance@lumenbank.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 03 May 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: personnel training/background & offboarding evidence for SOC 2 mapping

Hi Maya —

Thanks for the scope. We can absolutely assemble a narrow bundle for SOC 2 mapping. Proposed deliverables and approach below — aiming for delivery Tue EOD (2026-05-04):

1) Training roster (CSV) — non-PII pseudonyms (employee_###), role, hire date, training module IDs, completion dates, and training version. We'll include a short README that explains pseudonym mapping and our redaction policy.

2) Background-check confirmation — a vendor attestation letter (redacted) plus a one-page summary indicating checks completed (criminal + identity + employment verification) and date ranges. We will not include raw SSNs or DOBs.

3) Offboarding timeline example — a sample event log export (timestamps) showing account disable, key recall, and access removal across the primary systems (IAM, GCP projects, and internal admin tools). We'll provide two sample users: one full-time employee, one contractor.

4) Retention policy excerpt — text snippet from our personnel retention policy and the path where redacted artifacts are staged (s3://redwood-compliance-evidence/).

Attachments we plan to include: RB-training-roster-2025-redacted.csv, background-check-summary-redacted.pdf, offboard-timeline-2024-2026.csv, plus a README.

Questions we have before finalizing:
- Do you require vendor-signed PDFs or is a Redwood-signed attestation sufficient?
- For contractor records, do you want contractor company names included or redacted?

If those are OK, we'll send an initial bundle Tue morning and a final zipped package Tue EOD.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Customer Compliance 
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
(415) 555-0142

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, LumenBank Compliance <compliance@lumenbank.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 03 May 2026 11:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: personnel training/background & offboarding evidence for SOC 2 mapping

Vanessa / Maya —

Quick operational notes from infra/security to make sure we meet format expectations:

- Training roster: we'll include a salted-hash column (sha256) of the internal employee ID so your audit team can cross-reference without receiving any PII. We'll include the salt derivation note in the README.
- Background checks: our vendor (ClearVerify Inc.) will provide a short attestation PDF. If you need the vendor letter to be directly signed to LumenBank, we can request that but it may add 24–48 hours.
- Offboarding logs: to avoid sending raw logs, infra will produce a minimized CSV with event_type, resource, timestamp, and actor pseudonym. We'll also include an access revocation checklist (checklist.pdf) describing who performs each step.

Naomi — can you prep the sample CSVs and the vendor attestation request? I'll open a vendor ticket for signed confirmation if Maya requests it.

Jonas
Director, Security Operations
jonas.weber@redwood.com

From: Maya Brooks <compliance@lumenbank.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: S. Patel <s.patel@lumenbank.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 04 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: personnel training/background & offboarding evidence for SOC 2 mapping

Vanessa / Jonas —

Appreciate the clear plan — that works. Two clarifications from our auditor/Legal:
1) For the vendor attestation, a Redwood-mediated attestation (ClearVerify addressed to Redwood with a Redwood signature page) is acceptable for the first pass; we may request a vendor-to-client letter later.
2) For contractors, please include contractor company names but redact contact-level PII (emails/phones).

If you can send the initial bundle Tue morning for our internal review and the final zipped package Tue EOD, we'll confirm acceptance or follow-up questions by Wed. Thank you — expedited turnaround is appreciated.

Best,
Maya Brooks
Director, Vendor Risk — LumenBank
